dietPlan.title: Macro Split
dietPlan.subtitle: Metabolic Constants & Target Macros
dietPlan.balanceDesc: Based on WHO & USDA dietary guidelines, balancing energy availability, muscle protein synthesis (MPS), and metabolic health.
dietPlan.orientalHealthyDesc: Aligned with the Chinese Dietary Guidelines, emphasizing whole-grain complex carbs with low saturated fat for sustainable vitality.
dietPlan.mediterraneanDesc: Based on the PREDIMED clinical trial, prioritizing heart-healthy MUFAs and Omega-3s to optimize cardiovascular and metabolic markers.
dietPlan.highProteinDesc: Derived from ISSN guidelines to maximize muscle protein synthesis (MPS) and TEF while fueling resistance training.
dietPlan.lowCarbDesc: Informed by ADA carbohydrate restriction research, flattening insulin spikes and enhancing lipid oxidation while sparing lean mass.
dietPlan.ketoDesc: Grounded in Volek & Phinney nutritional ketosis protocols, depleting glycogen to stimulate hepatic ketone (BHB) production.
dietPlan.enduranceDesc: Based on the IOC consensus statement on sports nutrition, maximizing glycogen supercompensation for endurance performance.
dietPlan.contestPrepDesc: Cited from Helms et al. (JISSN bodybuilding prep), using 50% protein to defend against muscle catabolism during aggressive calorie deficits.
dietPlan.refeedDesc: Based on intermittent energy restriction research (Campbell et al.), transiently spiking leptin and glycogen to restore metabolic rate.
dietPlan.customDesc: Tailored to personalized precision nutrition protocols, ensuring macro ratios total 100% under energy balance principles.
dietPlan.syncTdeeTooltip: Set Target Calories to estimated TDEE

e1rmExplanation.title: e1RM (Estimated 1-Rep Max)
e1rmExplanation.desc: Estimates maximal single-rep capacity derived from completed weight and reps. Enables objective tracking of absolute strength progression without the injury risk of true 1RM testing.
e1rmExplanation.accuracy: Highest accuracy (< 3% margin) within 1-10 reps. Reps above 12 reflect localized muscular endurance and serve as general trend references.

body.title: Body

trendWeight.title: Trend Weight
trendWeight.desc: Daily scale weight fluctuates by 1~2 kg due to water retention, sodium, and digestion. By blending 85% historical baseline with 15% daily weight over a 7-day window, it filters out transient noise to objectively track true changes in fat and muscle tissue.

bmi.title: BMI
bmi.desc: Standard WHO metric assessing weight-to-height ratio to objectively quantify baseline body dimensions.

ffmi.title: FFMI
ffmi.desc: Fat-free mass index excluding adipose tissue to measure muscular development relative to height.

leanBodyMass.title: Lean Body Mass
leanBodyMass.desc: Total body mass excluding all adipose tissue, encompassing bones, skeletal muscles, internal organs, and fluids.

fatMass.title: Fat Mass
fatMass.desc: Absolute physical weight of total subcutaneous and visceral adipose tissue in the body.

vTaperRatio.title: Chest-to-Waist Ratio
vTaperRatio.desc: Objective geometric ratio evaluating upper body V-taper development, quantifying chest and lat proportion relative to the waist.

whRatio.title: Waist-to-Hip Ratio
whRatio.desc: Standard objective metric established by the WHO assessing body fat distribution and trunk proportions, measuring waist circumference relative to the hips.

body.recordWeightHint: Log today's weight to update trend metrics

trendLineExplanation.title: Trend Weight
trendLineExplanation.desc: Daily scale weight fluctuates by 1~2 kg due to water retention, sodium, and digestion. By blending 85% historical baseline with 15% daily weight over a 7-day window, it filters out transient noise to objectively track true changes in fat and muscle tissue.

weight.desc: Total physical mass of all bodily tissues and fluids; the primary baseline metric for energy balance and body composition.
weight.method: Weigh in the morning after voiding and before eating or drinking, wearing minimal clothing, standing still on a flat, hard surface.

bodyFat.desc: Percentage of total body weight composed of adipose tissue, reflecting lean mass versus fat distribution.
bodyFat.method: Measure using BIA, DEXA scan, or calipers under consistent hydration and physiological conditions.

shouldersCm.desc: Horizontal distance across the outermost points of the lateral deltoids, quantifying upper torso frame.
shouldersCm.method: Stand upright with relaxed shoulders and arms at sides; wrap a tape measure horizontally around the widest protrusion of both deltoids.

chestCm.desc: Circumference of the thorax across the widest point of the pectoral muscles, reflecting chest frame and torso development.
chestCm.method: Stand naturally with arms relaxed at sides; place tape horizontally around the nipple line and across the shoulder blades at the end of a normal exhalation.

waistCm.desc: Circumference at the narrowest point of the torso, serving as a primary marker for visceral fat and torso taper ratio.
waistCm.method: Stand upright with abdomen relaxed; wrap tape horizontally midway between the lowest rib and top of the iliac crest at the end of a normal exhalation.

hipsCm.desc: Circumference around the widest part of the buttocks and pelvis, used to calculate waist-to-hip ratio and lower body structure.
hipsCm.method: Stand upright with feet together; wrap tape horizontally around the maximal protrusion of the glutes, keeping tape parallel to the floor.

armsCm.desc: Maximal circumference around the upper arm, measuring muscular development of the biceps and triceps.
armsCm.method: Measure around the peak of the biceps perpendicular to the long axis of the humerus, either relaxed or flexed (maintain consistent method).

thighsCm.desc: Circumference around the thickest portion of the thigh, reflecting quadriceps and hamstrings mass.
thighsCm.method: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and weight distributed evenly; wrap tape horizontally around the maximal girth of the thigh just below the gluteal fold.

calvesCm.desc: Maximal horizontal circumference around the gastrocnemius and soleus muscles of the lower leg.
calvesCm.method: Stand naturally with weight evenly distributed; wrap tape horizontally around the widest point of the calf muscle belly.

hero.desc: Logging your body shouldn't cause anxiety. e2Cal delivers raw numbers with zero preaching or forced streaks. Fully offline, snappy, and private.

diet.titleLine2: Accurate Ingredients, One-Tap Copy, Quick Estimate, Rolling Average
diet.desc: Nutrition tracking should never be a chore. e2Cal offers four flexible workflows: weighed raw ingredients, one-tap copy from yesterday, quick estimates for dining out, and historical rolling averages.

raw.title: Precision Home Cooking
raw.desc: Physical scale baseline. Built-in constants for 420+ raw ingredients by grams, eliminating water retention bias.

copy.title: Zero-Effort Routine
copy.desc: Frictionless routine eating. Duplicate past identical meals with a single tap, zero manual re-entry.

estimate.title: Takeout & Social
estimate.desc: Zero anxiety when dining out. Preset calories and macros for common meals in seconds.

average.title: Effortless Average
average.desc: Default to regular intake. Smooth out daily fluid retention and fluctuations with 7-day and 30-day averages.

foodDb.label: Food Library
foodDb.desc: Raw weight baseline, zero cooked variance

recipes.label: Custom Recipes
recipes.desc: Pure ID references, zero snapshot drift

workout.titleLine2: Anatomy Heatmaps, Effective Sets & Pure Math e1RM
workout.desc: Strict separation of warm-up and working sets. Accurate weight and reps with battle-tested Brzycki / Epley e1RM formulas and weekly effective volume distribution.

body.titleLine1: Filter Fluid Noise, Reveal Real Progress
body.titleLine2: 7-Day Smoothed EMA, Body Circumferences & Objective Trends
body.desc: Fluid retention and sodium intake can swing body weight by 1-2 kg. e2Cal filters out noise with mathematical smoothing while tracking body circumferences.
body.chartFooter: Solid line: 7-day EMA trend · Hollow dots: daily raw readings

analytics.desc: No unverified AI scores or ratings. e2Cal provides instant objective metrics and formats them cleanly: export structured text for ChatGPT / Claude, or generate crisp high-resolution images.

sync.titleLine2: Full Offline Operation, Private Dropbox Sync & Single-File Backup
sync.desc: Your physiological data never passes through third-party cloud servers. Sync peer-to-peer with your personal Dropbox account, fully functional offline.

principles.titleLine2: No Social Feeds, No Streak Shaming, No Preaching, No Blackboxes
principles.desc: You don't need an app to nag you, preach, or compare you to others. e2Cal removes all cognitive clutter: whether you logged today or not, it remains a calm, sharp logging tool.
principles.manifestoDesc: No social feeds, no streak shaming, no preaching, no blackboxes. e2Cal is a calm logging tool that strips away every distraction.

item1.title: No Blackbox Lectures or Judgments
item1.desc: We never tell you that you ate too little, too much, or slipped up. No shaming red warning cards. The app is an objective mirror—100% of decisions belong to you.
item1.legacyBad: Carbs too high today. Run 40 min tomorrow to burn it off.
item1.factNote: Only objective facts from your logs. Eat more or less, move more or less—every choice is yours.

item2.tag: 02 // No Social Feeds or Peer Pressure
item2.title: Zero Peer Anxiety or Feed Noise
item2.desc: No discovery feed, no leaderboard, no comparisons. Quantified self is a serious dialogue between you and physics. You never need to perform discipline.
item2.legacyBad: Alex has lower body fat than 90% of peers—push harder to catch up.
item2.factGood: Local IndexedDB only · No public feed. Zero anxiety, no need to perform discipline.
item2.diffGood: Stored locally in IndexedDB · 0 public feeds

item3.title: True Discipline Needs No Shame Mechanism
item3.desc: No broken streak alerts or red badge urgency. If you logged today, that is a fact. If you didn't, tomorrow opens to the same clean, ready tool.
item3.legacyBad: Streak broken. Watch an ad or spend 50 gems to restore.
item3.factGood: Logged or not, facts are facts. Your body and life matter most—never feel ashamed of gaps.
item3.diffGood: Logged or not, facts are facts · Always ready

item4.title: Reject the “1 Bowl Beef Noodles = 750 kcal” Lie
item4.desc: Dish guessing is riddled with unpredictable cooking oil and water absorption bias. e2Cal grounds everything in raw ingredient constants.
item4.legacyBad: Fixed estimate: 1 Bowl Beef Noodles = 750 kcal
item4.diffGood: Beef Shank 150 g · Noodles 80 g · Olive Oil 8 g

tech.titleLine2: Zero Dependencies, Pure Client Math, Indestructible Data
tech.desc: No bloated tracking SDKs or heavy frameworks. Pure mathematical functions and 100% unit test coverage guarantee deterministic execution.
tech.summaryDesc: Zero third-party tracking, pure client computation, and indestructible local data. e2Cal runs on a lean modern web stack built for deterministic speed.
tech.ctaNote: No account · Offline ready · 100% local data

speed.title: 01 // Speed & Fluidity
speed.point1Desc: Code and data execute locally. No spinners, no network latency.
speed.point2Desc: Strict TypeScript typing eliminates runtime crashes and surprises.
speed.point3Desc: Carefully tuned for mobile screens. Stable viewports, no layout jumps.

safety.title: 02 // Indestructible Data
safety.point1Desc: Data stays on your hardware with persistent storage protection.
safety.point2Desc: Automatic safe migrations during app updates. Never lose history.
safety.point3Desc: Pure ID references for foods and workouts. Clean normalized relations.

math.title: 03 // Pure Math & Rigor
math.point1Desc: e1RM, EMA weight trends, and energy ratios computed with pure math.
math.point2Desc: Guaranteed 100% passing test suite covering edge cases.
math.point3Desc: Presents objective physiological facts without unsolicited ratings.
